root_cause.text: A race condition in f2fs_need_inode_block_update() where it reads nat_entry flags (IS_CHECKPOINTED and HAS_LAST_FSYNC) without proper synchronization, allowing it to observe these flags set by an in-progress checkpoint (via f2fs_flush_nat_entries) that has not yet completed, causing the function to incorrectly skip the inode block update and resulting in data loss on sudden power-off.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explains that f2fs_flush_nat_entries sets the flags during checkpoint write, but f2fs_need_inode_block_update() checks them without ensuring checkpoint completion, leading to false return. The patch adds acquisition of sbi->node_write lock before reading the nat_entry flags, ensuring that once the flags are observed, the checkpoint has fully completed.
